### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: the tag -> company pairs in E&F's own
### establish_bank_and_ef_compagnie (01_financial_scripted_effects.txt).
###
### WHY THIS EXISTS
###
### There is no effect in the game that gives an existing building to a company.
### add_ownership is a field of create_building and nothing else -- all ~1900
### uses in vanilla are inside one, and no ownership effect appears in
### effects_l_english.yml or common/effect_localization/. The only other route
### into company hands is privatisation, which is the AI's call and its timing.
### That is why the central bank had to be born owned instead of handed over.
###
### State scope. $CB_SIZE$ and $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$ come straight through from
### whichever E&F spawner called it.
###
### $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$ IS PASSED ON PURPOSE, even though every caller sets it to
### building_bank and this could name the building directly. An argument the
### callers pass and the effect does not use is a fatal compile error, not a
### warning, and it takes the whole effect down with it:
###
###   [jomini_script_argument.cpp:182]: Compiling source for failed for unknown
###   arguments: BANK_BLDG_TYPE. At
###   common/scripted_effects/09_introduction_building_lvl.txt:23498
###
### The result was every central bank in the world missing at game start, and
### not one line about it in error.log -- it is in debug.log.

			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_BankOfMontreal
					country = "c:QUE"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:RUS ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_StateBankRussianEmpire
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_StateBankRussianEmpire
					country = "c:RUS"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:SAF ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_BankSBoBSA
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_BankSBoBSA
					country = "c:SAF"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:SAR ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_CassaDiRisparmioDiTorino
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_CassaDiRisparmioDiTorino
					country = "c:SAR"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:SPA ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_BankofSpain
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_BankofSpain
					country = "c:SPA"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:SWE ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_HandelsBanken
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_HandelsBanken
					country = "c:SWE"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:SWI ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_Bankenverein
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_Bankenverein
					country = "c:SWI"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:TUR ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_OttomanBank
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_OttomanBank
					country = "c:TUR"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:URU ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_BancoCentralDelUruguay
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_BancoCentralDelUruguay
					country = "c:URU"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
				c:VNZ ?= this
				has_company = company_type:company_BancoCentralDeVenezuela
			}
		}
		create_building = {
			building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
			level    = $CB_SIZE$
			reserves = 1
			add_ownership = {
				company = {
					type    = company_BancoCentralDeVenezuela
					country = "c:VNZ"
					levels  = $CB_SIZE$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		### No flavoured central bank, or the country does not hold it yet --
		### Germany's Reichsbank is 1876 and its central bank is built in 1836.
		### company_BasicBank has uses_dynamic_naming, so it comes out as a named
		### bank rather than a placeholder. The slot is granted first: a country
		### with no free company slot -- Finland in 1836 -- cannot take one.
		scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter } }
				add_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_company = company_type:company_BasicBank } }
				add_company = company_type:company_BasicBank
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
					has_company = company_type:company_BasicBank
				}
			}
			create_building = {
				building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
				level    = $CB_SIZE$
				reserves = 1
				add_ownership = {
					company = {
						type    = company_BasicBank
						country = scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner
						levels  = $CB_SIZE$
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			### LAST RESORT, AND IT EXISTS FOR A REASON. This is E&F's own line,
			### untouched. When the dispatcher failed the first time, every central
			### bank in the world simply stopped existing -- there was no path left
			### that just builds the thing. A state-owned bank beats no bank.
			create_building = {
				building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
				level    = $CB_SIZE$
				reserves = 1
			}
		}
	}
}
